subtopics.title: Capital Accounts, Current Accounts and the Agreement

questions.question: Under a fixed-capital agreement, a partner's capital account changes only when:
options: The partner formally contributes or withdraws capital, with agreement
Profit is shared at year end

questions.question: A DEBIT balance on a partner's current account means:
options: The partner has drawn more than they have earned and owes the business
The partner's capital has been withdrawn

questions.question: Interest on capital at 9 percent for Molefe, who contributed R400 000, is:
Partners earn interest and salaries from their own partnership because of which GAAP principle?
options: Business entity — the partnership's records are kept apart from the partners' private affairs

questions.question: The February telephone account of R1 850 arrives in March. The year-end adjustment is:
options: No entry until the bill is paid

questions.question: Rent income of R41 600 includes March rent received early. With rent at R3 200 per month, the income statement must show:
options: R38 400 — twelve months at R3 200, with R3 200 moved to income received in advance

questions.question: Equipment with a carrying value of R64 000 is depreciated at 10 percent on the diminishing balance. This year's depreciation is:
Stock records show R187 300 but the count finds R185 200. The correct treatment is:
options: Ignore the difference until next year
Debit Trading stock, credit Trading stock deficit R2 100
Debit Trading stock deficit, credit Trading stock R2 100 — and investigate the loss

questions.question: Creating a provision for bad debts of R2 400 on debtors of R48 000 requires:
options: Debit Provision for bad debts adjustment, credit Provision for bad debts R2 400
Debit Bad debts, credit Debtors control R2 400
Debit Debtors control, credit Provision for bad debts R2 400
Debit Provision for bad debts, credit Bank R2 400

questions.question: The provision differs from bad debts because the provision:
options: Removes a named debtor from the books
Is a percentage held against debtors we cannot yet name, while bad debts writes off a known debtor
Is paid to debtors in cash

questions.question: Debtors rise to R56 000 and the provision must stand at 5 percent. The existing provision is R2 400. The entry is:
options: Create a new provision of R2 800
Credit Provision for bad debts adjustment R400
Debit Provision for bad debts adjustment R400, credit Provision for bad debts R400 — only the movement touches profit
Debit Provision for bad debts R2 800

questions.question: Interest of R18 000 is capitalised on the Thebe Bank loan. The credit entry goes to:
options: The Loan account itself — no money moves; the debt grows

subtopics.title: Reversals on the First of March

questions.question: Without reversing the accrued telephone expense of R1 850, the March payment would:
options: Count the same expense twice, once in each year

questions.question: The reversal of income received in advance on 1 March is:
options: Debit Rent income, credit Income received in advance
Debit Income received in advance, credit Rent income R3 200

questions.question: Which of the following is NEVER reversed at the start of the new year?
options: Depreciation — it records value genuinely consumed, not a timing shift

questions.question: The test for whether an adjustment is reversed is:
options: Whether it appears in the income statement
Whether it moved an amount across the year-end boundary — timing shifts reverse; permanent losses stay

subtopics.title: Two Friends, One Till, Two Scorecards

questions.question: In the kota shop picture, the money written on the wall stands for:
options: Fixed capital — what each partner planted, touched only by formal agreement

questions.question: Sipho taking airtime and bread from the shop is recorded as:
options: Drawings on the debit side of his current account scorecard
A reduction of his capital on the wall
An expense of the shop called groceries

questions.question: Salaries, interest on capital and the profit-sharing ratio are decided by:
options: The partner who invested the most

questions.question: The provision for bad debts is described as a dimmer switch because:
options: It dims the debtors figure to what we prudently expect to collect, and next year only the dial's movement touches profit
It removes named debtors one by one

questions.question: With the dial at 5 percent, debtors of R56 000 need a provision of:
options: R2 800 — so the existing R2 400 provision rises by R400

questions.question: The loan sentence — what I owed, plus what it grew, minus what I paid — gives a closing balance of:
options: R138 000 — from R150 000 plus R18 000 interest less the R30 000 repayment

questions.question: Capitalised interest means the shop's bank balance:
options: Is untouched by the interest — only the loan debt grows

subtopics.title: Flipping the Switches on Day One

questions.question: After the 1 March reversal, the telephone account starts the new year:
options: R1 850 in credit, so the arriving bill's payment nets it to nil
With a balance owing to the phone company

questions.question: Which set of adjustments gets flipped on day one?
options: Depreciation, stock deficit, bad debts, provision
Accrued expenses, prepaid expenses, income received in advance, accrued income

questions.question: Depreciation is not reversed because:
options: It is too small to matter
It was recorded in the journal
The bakkie really wore out — the loss is permanent, not a shuffle between years
The new year re-charges it anyway

questions.question: The two principles served by adjustments and reversals together are:
options: Matching — each rand in its own year — and prudence — never paint the picture prettier than it is
